fix_code:
def calculate_minimum_passengers():
    n = int(input())
    alist = list(map(int, input().split()))
    current_passengers = 0
    min_passengers = 0
    for i in range(n):
        current_passengers += alist[i]
        min_passengers = min(min_passengers, current_passengers)
    print(abs(min_passengers))
